parts.content: Perform a thorough READ-ONLY audit of d:\PropelExp. Do not edit any files. Review .propel/context/docs/brd.md, spec.md, epics.md and every artifact under .propel/context/tasks/EP-001 through EP-008, EP-DATA, EP-TECH. Also inspect project-config/knowledge files only if needed to understand artifact locations or traceability. Determine: (1) inventory of epics and user stories, (2) whether every BRD/spec functional and nonfunctional requirement is covered by an epic and story, (3) whether every epic has complete aligned stories, (4) inconsistencies in IDs, personas, scope, dependencies, acceptance criteria, business rules, NFRs, data, security/accessibility/observability/error states, (5) duplicates or contradictions, and (6) missing stories. Ground every finding with workspace-relative file paths and 1-based line numbers. Rank findings Critical/High/Medium/Low. Clearly distinguish confirmed gaps from ambiguous items. Return a concise but comprehensive report and do not suggest or make implementation changes.
